An anonymous black-box function of 6 continuous inputs in [0, 1]; lower is better.

## Inputs
| parameter | type | domain | scale |
|---|---|---|---|
| `x_e76` | real | [0, 1] | linear |
| `x_ec1` | real | [0, 1] | linear |
| `x_c47` | real | [0, 1] | linear |
| `x_e64` | real | [0, 1] | linear |
| `x_346` | real | [0, 1] | linear |
| `x_a76` | real | [0, 1] | linear |

## Outputs
- `y`: objective; minimize (lower is better).

## Noise
Observations are noiseless: repeated evaluations of the same input return the same value.
